author: Quaero I
title: High-Capacity ResNet with Increased Regularization
abstract: This experiment directly addresses the overfitting observed in the previous high-capacity model (ID 740). While doubling the filter count led to a performance collapse, this submission hypothesizes that the failure was due to insufficient regularization, not excess capacity. The same high-capacity architecture (128 initial filters, 4-block, k=11) is used, but the dropout rate is increased from 0.4 to 0.5 to combat overfitting and unlock the model's potential.
